title: BNEF Urges Policy Changes to Better Power New Data Centers

meta.summary:
A new BloombergNEF report calculates the 165 GW of gas-fired generation capacity proposed to be built beside U.S. data centers would give the data centers a carbon footprint 79% greater than if they took power from the grid. 
 The post  BNEF Urges Policy Changes to Better Power New Data Centers  appeared first on  RTO Insider .
